# PPK integration data

These are real GPS observations and broadcast ephemerides from RTKLIB's official
test data, at commit `180043ee24b6d2b168f98b64be15f69d50046b1a`:

- rover.obs: test/data/rinex/07590920.05o
- base.obs: test/data/rinex/30400920.05o
- navigation.nav: test/data/rinex/07590920.05n

Source: https://github.com/tomojitakasu/RTKLIB/tree/180043ee24b6d2b168f98b64be15f69d50046b1a/test/data/rinex

The headers identify GSI Japan and the acquisition dates. No coordinates,
observations, ephemerides, or expected solution qualities have been invented.
The upstream BSD license is retained in third_party/rtklib/LICENSE.txt.
